source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Build the army within the [Select Battle Size](vsdata:core-rule/select-battle-size) limits and every restriction its rules, units and detachments set; no unit, attached ones included, may have more than 1 Enhancement.

1. Detachments: spend DP on different detachments open to your **army faction** and record them. An Incursion army normally has 2 DP but may take a single 3 DP detachment as its only one.
2. Units: pick units bearing your faction keyword or open to your army faction, with whatever wargear and options they have; record each one's model count, wargear, upgrades and points.
3. Warlord: pick a **CHARACTER** unit with your army faction keyword, then a **CHARACTER** model in it, and record it; that model gains **WARLORD**. If you include units that must be your **WARLORD**, pick 1 of them; a rule barring a model from being **WARLORD** beats one requiring it.
4. Leaders and Supports: you may attach each to a bodyguard unit it can join (19.01); every Support must be attached.
5. Enhancements: take them from your detachments, each on a different unit, adding their points to that unit.

Unless a rule says otherwise, only **CHARACTER** units take Enhancements (pick 1 **CHARACTER** model in the unit), **EPIC HEROES** never do, and each Enhancement is limited to 1 per army.

Upgrades are the exception: a non-**CHARACTER** unit may take one, and an army may hold up to 3 copies of one Upgrade; copies 2 and 3 still cost points but don't count toward the army's Enhancement total.
